Pinned REAPER extension DLLs bundled by installer/setup.iss.

These MUST keep their exact original GitHub release filenames -
ReaPack in particular self-checks that its loaded module's path and
filename exactly match "UserPlugins/reaper_reapack-<arch>.dll" (see its
own CMakeLists.txt) and refuses to load with a warning ("was not loaded
from a standard extension path or its filename was altered") if you
rename it. An earlier version of this bundling renamed both files to
"reaper_imgui64.dll"/"reaper_reapack64.dll" (an older manual-install
convention seen in some community writeups) and hit exactly that
ReaPack warning - don't repeat that; always ship the release asset
as-is.

reaper_imgui-x64.dll
  Source:  cfillion/reaimgui
  Version: v0.10.0.5
  From:    https://github.com/cfillion/reaimgui/releases/download/v0.10.0.5/reaper_imgui-x64.dll

reaper_reapack-x64.dll
  Source:  cfillion/reapack
  Version: v1.2.6
  From:    https://github.com/cfillion/reapack/releases/download/v1.2.6/reaper_reapack-x64.dll

To update: download the new release's *-x64.dll asset from the
project's GitHub releases page, replace the file here unchanged (same
filename), and update this file's version/URL. No other changes needed
- setup.iss references these two filenames directly.
